title: pyrola secunda subsp. obtusata
intro: Pyrola secunda subsp. obtusata, commonly known as Bearberry Wintergreen, is a plant species that belongs to the Pyrolaceae family. It is a perennial herb with oval-shaped leaves and white, bell-shaped flowers. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in reducing pain, swelling, and fever. The bioactive constituents of Bearberry Wintergreen include phenolic compounds, such as salicin and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects.
